title: Strict exponential bound on the sign cube
statement: Let $n$ and $s$ be natural numbers with $n>0$, and let $L,\delta\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $L>0$, $\delta>0$, and $4nL^2/\delta^2\le s$. The number of sign vectors in $\{-1,1\}^n$, multiplied by $2\exp\!\left(-s(\delta/L)^2/2\right)$, is strictly less than $1$.
